findings.area: agenda row — Champions League, "Fenerbahce – Slavia Prague" (18:45, tirsdag, "I morgen")
findings.issue: The crest slot shows a plain red five-pointed star, not Fenerbahçe's actual club crest (yellow/navy shield). Neighboring Champions League rows in the same block (Napoli, PSG, VfB Stuttgart, etc.) all render a correct, specific club crest, so this looks like a missing/unmapped crest asset for this one club rather than a general icon failure.

findings.area: agenda row — Champions League, "Sabah – Borussia Dortmund" (18:45, tirsdag, "I morgen")
findings.issue: The crest shown is Borussia Dortmund's (black/yellow "BVB" badge) — the AWAY team — even though the row is laid out "Sabah – Borussia Dortmund" and every other row in the agenda (e.g. "Monza – Cagliari", "Como – Manchester United", "Borussia Dortmund – Eintracht Frankfurt" later in the week) shows the FIRST-listed team's crest. Sabah's own crest is missing/not shown, and the Dortmund badge appearing in that slot reads as if Dortmund were the home side.

findings.area: agenda row — Champions League, "Lille – Galatasaray" (18:45, onsdag 21. oktober)
findings.issue: The crest shown is a yellow/red lion-style badge that matches Galatasaray's branding, not Lille's actual crest (navy/red "LOSC" shield) — the same first-listed-team-crest mismatch pattern as the Sabah/Dortmund row above, recurring across at least two Champions League fixtures this week.

findings.area: agenda row — Eliteserien, "Viking – Tromsø" (14:30, søndag 25. oktober)
findings.issue: The icon in the crest slot is a small flag-style graphic with horizontal red/yellow/red stripes — it reads as the Spanish national flag, not a Viking FK club crest. Every other Eliteserien row visible in the agenda (Bodø/Glimt – Vålerenga, Arsenal... / HamKam – Rosenborg, Sandefjord – Runar Elite) renders an actual, correct club crest, so this one stands out as a wrong/misplaced icon rather than an intentional "no crest available" fallback (handball rows use a plain calendar icon for that case, which looks different from this).

notes: Checked at 375/393/900px in the light (grouped-light) theme — full-page captures per the standard three commands, plus additional non-full-page / scrolled viewport captures at the same widths to read small text and crests at full fidelity (the very tall full-page PNGs get downsampled enough on display to blur fine detail like crest artwork).
No horizontal scroll or clipped/truncated text found at any width, including 375px — multi-word fixtures and headline text wrap onto extra lines cleanly; nothing is cut off at the screen edge.

Channel column is consistently Norwegian (TV 2 Play, Viaplay, HBO Max (Sport), VG TV) wherever a channel is known; unknown channels show an honest faint '–' (several Bundesliga/Serie A fixtures) rather than guessing. No foreign broadcaster (FOX/ESPN/Sky) seen anywhere.

Most club crests render correctly and crisply — Monza, Parma, Tottenham, Getafe, Chelsea, Valencia, Borussia Dortmund (as the away/home team elsewhere), Lazio, Atlético Madrid, Internazionale, Athletic Club, Bodø/Glimt, Arsenal, HamKam, Napoli, PSG, Barcelona, Real Madrid, VfB Stuttgart, Como all show a clearly correct, specific crest — the four crest mismatches above are isolated to specific clubs/rows, not a general rendering failure.

Handball/non-football rows (Kolstad – SC Magdeburg, Viking TIF – Drammen handball, Sandefjord – Runar Elite) show either a real crest or a plain generic calendar icon, which reads as an intentional 'no crest asset for this sport' fallback, distinct from the wrong-crest cases flagged above.
Must-see accent dots are used sparingly (a handful of rows per day), not on every row — consistent with the calm-design intent.

The floating 'Assistent' button overlaps mid-agenda rows at all three widths, as sanctioned by DESIGN.md — checked the actual end of the page (last agenda/news row and the full footer: 'Oppdatert 19.10.2026', 'Abonner i kalender', 'last ned', 'Aktivitet', 'Personvern', AI-budsjett line) at 375px and 900px, and the button sits clear of all of it in both cases — no occlusion finding.
Header, 'Dette dekker vi' / 'Merker og kilder' disclosures, and footer are all intact and aligned at every width checked.
Round/stage labels (e.g. cup round names) were not observed in the current schedule window — nothing in view required one, so this could not be assessed either way.
